item.title: Theon adjusted EBIT rises 37.5% to €65.1 million in H1 FY26; revenue increases 35.4% to €248.7 million
item.description: Theon International published its H1 2026 report, with revenue up 35.4% to €248.7 million. Adjusted EBIT climbed 37.5% to €65.1 million; adjusted EBIT mar
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Theon International published its H1 2026 report, with revenue up 35.4% to €248.7 million. Adjusted EBIT climbed 37.5% to €65.1 million; adjusted EBIT margin widened 0.4 percentage points to 26.2%. Order intake rose 38.5% to €232.5 million; soft backlog increased 2.5% to €1.46 billion. Net debt edged up 4.3% to €237.9 million; financial leverage eased to 1.7x from 1.8x. CEO Christian Hadjiminas cited acquisitions and partnerships expanding the addressable market to nearly €8 billion; FY 2026 revenue guided at about €600 million. item.title: TFF Group launches TFF Upcycling unit for second-life barrel recovery and resale
item.description: Tonnellerie François Frères launched TFF Upcycling as a new subsidiary focused on take-back, refurbishment, resale of barrels no longer used by wineries. Th
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tonnellerie François Frères launched TFF Upcycling as a new subsidiary focused on take-back, refurbishment, resale of barrels no longer used by wineries. The move extends the group’s vertical integration beyond manufacturing into second-life barrel management, aligned with its ESG strategy. The unit targets a fragmented used-barrel market, adding wine-related volumes to an existing resale activity serving the whisky market. The process requires a resale agreement before barrels are taken back, aiming to limit inventory risk. Management expects a sector rebound no earlier than fiscal 2027/2028. item.title: Klaria partners with RTHS to develop early migraine detection technology
item.description: Klaria Pharma entered a collaboration with Gothenburg-based RTHS to develop earlier migraine detection and earlier treatment. RTHS will use non-invasive sen
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Klaria Pharma entered a collaboration with Gothenburg-based RTHS to develop earlier migraine detection and earlier treatment. RTHS will use non-invasive sensors and algorithms tracking blood-flow dynamics to flag migraine attacks before symptoms start. Klaria’s EU-cleared Sumatriptan Alginate Film is positioned as the rapid, on-demand treatment paired with earlier attack detection. Partnership aims to improve attack control, support more consistent acute treatment, reduce progression risk toward chronic migraine. item.title: Deutsche Telekom partners with third-party networks on T Secure Fabric enterprise platform
item.description: Deutsche Telekom unveiled T Secure Fabric, a global enterprise networking platform combining its infrastructure with selected partner networks and services.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Deutsche Telekom unveiled T Secure Fabric, a global enterprise networking platform combining its infrastructure with selected partner networks and services. The partner ecosystem aims to add alternative connection paths, broader reach, greater resilience, and faster integration of new sites, clouds, and data centers. Deutsche Telekom will manage the end-to-end solution, integrating multiple providers and technologies under a single control layer for customers.
